items.name: button
items.title: AK Button
items.description: Arknights-inspired action button with composable variants and slots.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: The component imports the @yunyoujun/ak-ui CSS Core automatically. Override --ak-* variables in your global stylesheet to customize the theme.

items.name: card
items.title: AK Card
items.description: Composable Arknights-inspired card with header, title, description, content, and footer primitives.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: Compose AkCardHeader, AkCardTitle, AkCardDescription, AkCardContent, and AkCardFooter instead of placing all content in one slot.

items.name: input-number
items.title: AK Input Number
items.description: Accessible numeric input with increment, decrement, minimum, and maximum actions.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: Use v-model for the numeric value. The component clamps button and typed input changes to min and max.

items.name: status
items.title: AK Status
items.description: Tags and live terminal status indicators for roles, rarity, warnings, and connectivity.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: Use AkTag for compact classifications and AkStatus for a signal, code label, and descriptive state.

items.name: progress
items.title: AK Progress
items.description: Accessible horizontal progress and octagonal gauge adapters with clamped values.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: AkProgress and AkGauge keep aria-valuenow synchronized with the clamped visual percentage.

items.name: notice
items.title: AK Notice
items.description: Tactical information, warning, danger, and success notices with semantic live roles.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: Danger notices default to role=alert; other variants default to role=status. The role can be overridden.

items.name: tabs
items.title: AK Tabs
items.description: Controlled Vue tabs and segmented mode selection with keyboard navigation.
items.author: YunYouJun
items.docs: Use v-model for the active item. Arrow keys, Home, and End move focus and selection between tabs.
